narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three times four is twelve, so the answer is twelve to the power four.
<bookmark mark='only'/>The small four sits on the base four only, not on the three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We must work out four to the power four before we multiply by three.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 3 × 4⁴ = 12⁴; the exponent 4 is circled with only the 4 under it; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, write each power as a chain of factors and multiply again.
<bookmark mark='sign'/>Then check the sign by counting the negative factors.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line write each power as a chain of factors appears; the check line odd count of negatives, negative answer appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu turns three times four to the power four into twelve to the power four. The power belongs only to the four, so the bubble is struck.
